title: Leader
subtitle: 「領袖／主管／負責人／先驅／領軍力量」，究竟是哪一種 leader？
description: 「領袖／主管／負責人／先驅／領軍力量」，究竟是哪一種 leader？

words.note: 非常常見，表示一個部門、組織、機構或團隊的最高負責人。
words.example: She is the head of the research department.

falseSynonyms.zh: head 強調組織或部門的正式最高負責人；leader 可以更廣，包括非正式、思想或運動領袖。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is the head of the department. He emerged as a leader of the protest movement.

falseSynonyms.zh: manager 側重管理執行、資源和人員；leader 可強調方向、影響與帶領。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The manager prepared the weekly rota. The leader set the long-term direction.

falseSynonyms.zh: director 常是正式職銜；leader 不一定有該職稱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The programme director approved the budget. She became a respected leader in the sector.

falseSynonyms.zh: pioneer 是率先開創者；有些 pioneer 並不管理任何團隊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He was a pioneer of early computing. She is the current leader of the research group.

falseSynonyms.zh: front-runner 是競爭中目前領先者，不是管理或指揮角色。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The candidate is the front-runner in the contest. The team leader coordinates the project.

falseSynonyms.zh: figurehead 可能只有象徵身份而沒有實權；leader 一般可暗示實際帶領。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The monarch serves largely as a figurehead. The operational leader made the final decision.

falseSynonyms.zh: commander 限於軍事、警務或行動指揮等語境，不能泛化至一般組織。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The commander issued the order. The charity's leader addressed volunteers.

falseSynonyms.zh: leader 指人或領先者；leadership 指領導行為、能力或領導層整體。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She is an effective leader. The organisation needs stronger leadership.
